newsitem.title: USA: Cox, Frontier Corp enter phone pact.
newsitem.headline: Cox, Frontier Corp enter phone pact.

text.p: Cox Communications Inc and Frontier Corp said Tuesday they had entered into a deal to offer long-distance telephone service to customers in select Cox markets beginning in the first quarter of 1997.

Cox said the five-year agreement calls for Cox to handle all marketing and sales to customers, while Frontier provides the long-distance network, telecommunications services, monthly billing and customer service.
Cox said that through the deal with Frontier, its long-distance service will offer customers a choice of two simple, straightforward calling plans.
